title: rust-security-orb run record, version 1
description: What one rust-security-orb command ran, on what, and what it wrote: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when a command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no findings. findings: findings failed the step. findings-reported: findings, passed because report_only is true. error: the tool did not complete, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: The tool's own exit code (for audit_bin, the last binary's; for verify_auditable, 1 when a binary has no data; when a SARIF pass or auditable2cdx fails, its own).

ci.description: The CircleCI job, from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1 and CIRCLE_JOB; null outside CircleCI.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in. Relative paths in arguments are relative to it.

tool.description: The tool binary the command ran.

other_tools.description: Other binaries the command ran, each described as tool is: auditable2cdx for verify_auditable with cyclonedx, rust-audit-info for audit_bin with require_auditable, and none otherwise.

arguments.description: The arguments the tool ran with, after the binary's name, except the options the command adds to read the tool's results (cargo audit's --json, cargo deny's --format json and --log-level info, cargo vet's --output-format json and --output-file) and the binaries audit_bin and verify_auditable read, which are in inputs.

toolchain.description: What cargo --version and rustc --version print on the PATH; null when one isn't there.

advisory_db.description: The RustSec advisory database read by audit, audit_bin or deny; null for the other commands, and when it can't be known.

commit.description: The newest commit; null when the directory has no git history.

inputs.description: The files the result depends on, by role: lockfile, manifest (the workspace's Cargo.toml files), config, metadata, store or binary.

sha256.description: null when the file doesn't exist.

counts.description: The command's own summary of what it found, such as vulnerabilities and denied warnings for audit, or errors and warnings per check for deny. null when the tool did not complete.

reports.description: Every report the command wrote, with its SHA-256.

version.description: What the binary reports as its version; empty when it reports none.

install.description: How the orb installed the binary that ran, from the record its install command left beside it. null when there is none, or when it describes another binary than the one that ran.

arch.description: The checksum table entry's architecture: amd64 or arm64 for a release binary, noarch for a crate's source archive, which is built for the machine it is installed on.

method.description: prebuilt: a release binary. source-built: built with cargo install --locked from a crate source archive.

asset.description: The file that was verified: the release asset or the crate's source archive.

asset_sha512.description: The SHA-512 the orb's checksum table lists for it; empty when it was not verified.
